subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu add a supported attachment-content opt-out, and should that be a Feishu per-account/top-level option or a shared channel media policy?
rationale: The reported `ignoreFileContent` key is not a current documented Feishu contract, and adding one changes config/default behavior for a channel that currently downloads inbound media.

options.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented Feishu-owned option that defaults to current download behavior and sends placeholder-only context when disabled.

options.title: Use Shared Media Policy
options.body: Route Feishu through a broader channel attachment-ingestion policy if maintainers want one canonical knob across channels.

options.title: Document No Opt-Out
options.body: Keep `mediaMaxMb` as the only supported control and document that Feishu currently has no file-content-ignore setting.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented Feishu-owned option that defaults to current download behavior and sends placeholder-only context when disabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu media hardening and docs work makes this the best available routing owner for the attachment policy choice.
